load_model_for_depth_estimation: load a MiDaS depth estimation model with a specified type and device for inference
load_model_with_custom_height: load a MiDaS model with a custom inference height and square resize option
load_model_with_openvino: load an OpenVINO-optimized MiDaS small model for CPU-based depth estimation inference
load_model_with_optimization: load a MiDaS model on CUDA with half-precision and channels-last memory optimization
review_default_models: review the default_models dictionary to find available MiDaS model types and their weight paths
